# WORKFLOW NAME
name: Multiple Jobs Deployment Based on the Conditions

# EVENTS
on:
    push: 
        branches: 
            - develop

    pull_request:
        branches:
            - staging

# GLOBAL VARIABLES
env:
    AWS_REGION: us-east-1
    AWS_ECR_REPOSITORY: my-tech-profile
    AWS_ECR_REGISTRY: 128833122451.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

# JOBS SECTION
jobs:

    # LINT JOB 
    # In GitHub Actions, 
    # Linting is used to automatically analyze your source code to catch programmatic errors, syntax bugs, and stylistic violations before they are merged. 
    # It serves as a quality gate in your CI/CD Pipeline, ensuring that all contributed code follows a consistent style and meets established best practices.
    # It is a mandatory to use in GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
    # Lint
    Validate-Application:

        # RUN THIS JOB ONLY WHEN DEVELOP BRANCH PUSHED
        if: github.ref_name == 'develop'

        # OS RUNNER
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        timeout-minutes: 10

        strategy:
            matrix: 
                node-version: [18.x, 20.x]

        steps:
            # CHECKOUT TO SOURCE CODE
          - name: Checkout Source
            uses: actions/checkout@v4

            # SETUP NODEJS FOR REACT JS PROJECT
          - name: Setup NodeJs
            uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
                node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

          - name: Install Dependencies
            run: |
                npm install

          - name: Run ESlint
            run: |
                npm run lint

    # BUILD DOCKER IMAGE
    Build-And-Push-Image:
        # RUN ONLY AFTER LINT SUCCESS
        needs: Validate-Application

        if: success() && github.ref_name == 'develop'

        runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        # PREVENT MULTIPLE DOCKER IMAGE PUSH SIMULTANEOUSLY
        concurrency:
            group: develop-build
            cancel-in-progress: true

        # TIMEOUT PROTECTION
        timeout-minutes: 20

        outputs:
            image_tag: ${{ github.sha }}

        steps:
            # CHECKOUT TO SOURCE
          - name: Checkout Source
            uses: actions/checkout@v4

            # CONFIGURE AWS CREDENTIAL
          - name: Configure AWS Credentials
            uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
            with:
                aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
                aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
                aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

            # LOGIN TO AWS ECR
          - name: Login to AWS ECR
            uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

            # BUILD DOCKER IMAGE
          - name: Build Docker Image
            run: |
                docker build -t ${{ env.AWS_ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }} .

            # TAG DOCKER IMAGE
          - name: Tag Docker Image
            run: |
                docker tag \
                    ${{ env.AWS_ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }} \
                        ${{ env.AWS_ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.AWS_ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }}

            # PUSH DOCKER IMAGE TO AWS ECR
          - name: Push Docker Image to AWS ECR
            run: |
                docker push \
                    ${{ env.AWS_ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.AWS_ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }}

    # DEPLOY DOCKER IMAGE TO ECS
    Deploy-On-Develop:
        needs: Build-And-Push-Image

        if: success() && github.ref_name == 'develop'

        runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        environment: develop

        concurrency:
            group: develop-deploy
            cancel-in-progress: true

        timeout-minutes: 20
